visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is set in a bright, modern indoor living and dining area. A woman with purple-dyed hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a pink bunny-ear headband, sits at a white dining table. She is initially looking at a boy in a pink long-sleeved shirt and glasses who stands before her. (2) The boy presents a long-stemmed pink flower wrapped in plastic. The woman claps her hands excitedly and laughs with a wide-open mouth, expressing surprise. A toddler girl in a pink ruffled dress walks into the frame from the background. (3) The woman takes the flower and holds it, smiling broadly. The toddler approaches her, reaching for the flower. A golden retriever dog with a harness walks around the living room area in the background, near a white sofa and a play slide. (4) The boy pulls out a pink handmade card from a bag. The woman takes the card, opens it, and points to the text inside, her face showing a mix of joy and mock-crying emotion. (5) Later, the boy presents a large heart-shaped gift made of blue and yellow textured materials. The woman holds it up to the camera, revealing its back side which contains printed text and a QR code, then hugs the boy warmly. (6) The camera follows the woman as she interacts with the toddler and the dog, showing more of the apartment interior including a kitchen island and a decorative Mickey Mouse artwork on the wall.
